scope: one paired, three-turn pilot; no fresh-session continuity claim
acceptance: edit preserves registration identity and count
usage: sum root and descendant session totals; cached input is subset of input; reasoning output is subset of output; supervisor excluded
stage2: One-page no-account waitlist, automatic FIFO promotion on cancellation, case-insensitive uniqueness across both lists, reload persistence.
stage3: Edit name/email in place for either status; identity/order/count preservation, duplicate rejection, narrow mobile refinement.
limits: No fresh-session continuity or population-level effectiveness claim.

scoring.capacity: six confirmed maximum; next joins waitlist
scoring.fifo: oldest waitlisted entry promoted on cancellation
scoring.edit_booking: id and count preserved; details change
scoring.edit_waitlist: id and index preserved; details change
scoring.mobile: no horizontal overflow at 375px; primary controls visible and usable
scoring.desktop: booking form and lists usable at 1280px
